content.short: BTC Direct is a European crypto broker and onramp provider serving retail and business customers.
content.description: BTC Direct is one of the longer-established European crypto brokers, offering direct purchase for retail customers and onramp infrastructure for businesses across the region. European onramps compete largely on local payment method coverage, since card acceptance for crypto purchases remains inconsistent across the continent.
